properties.origin: center between four grade-level baseplate centers; Blender Z=0

interpretation: All 12 seat-bottom samples meet the bearer tops within 0.00000003 m; three supports join the rear assembly.
Screens are intentionally offset from rails. Their clips bridge the gap; direct screen-to-rail contact is not required.
Vertex-to-surface distance is not a complete minimum-distance test and is misleading for large coplanar faces. Use the dedicated seat rays and triangle intersection evidence.
Gutter center ray misses the gutter floor through the modeled drain opening; this verifies an opening, not hydraulic function.
Contacts and closed part topology are static art evidence, not structural or gameplay acceptance.
